name: carousel
summary: A snapping carousel whose neighbouring slides shrink, fade or tilt with the scroll.
props: Items to render, one slide each.
Render a slide. `progress` runs -1 → 0 → 1 across the centre — use it for parallax.
Fraction of the carousel (≤ 1) or points. Capped at 460pt for tablets.
Indicator under the slides; dots are tappable.
Advance every 3.5s (or N ms); pauses while touched.
Autoplay wraps to the first slide.
Controlled active slide. Pair with onIndexChange so autoplay / swipes update parent state.
Uncontrolled initial slide (ignored when index is set).
Fires when the centred slide changes (swipe, dots, autoplay).
Style for the root view wrapping the slides and pagination.
behavior: Swipe to snap from slide to slide. Autoplay waits while you drag and resumes after.
Slide effects are interpolated from the scroll position on the native driver. renderItem also gets a progress value for your own parallax.
The scroller is adjustable, reads "Slide 2 of 5" and supports increment and decrement. Dots are buttons labelled "Go to slide N".
Settles on the nearest slide once scrolling stops, since the web has no snap momentum.
